title: dpia.status_changed payload (v1)
description: Wire payload of `dpia.status_changed`. Carries `is_activating` as evaluated at this event's own `occurred_at`, so a subscriber cannot read `status: approved` and miss that the approval had already expired. No field in this payload carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a party or authority handle, a document or its bytes, message content, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13; Framework 0.8.1 section 11).
